title: THE RIVER REMEMBERS
story: A voice calls beyond the northern mountains. Two sisters follow it into a forest sealed by mist—and discover that their kingdom’s proudest monument hides its darkest secret.
art: Epic wide view: Eira and Lina on a high snowy ledge on the RIGHT, blue enchanted forest far below and distant glacier glowing beneath aurora. Eira raises an ice-lit hand; a large diamond-shaped ice crystal rests on a stone pedestal lower right. Strong scale and diagonal cold wind.

title: WORDS HAVE POWER
story: Use the present simple for habits, repeated actions and facts. Choose the correct command to help the travellers. Correct answers earn 5 points; story choices earn 2–4. Your total decides how the journey ends.

title: A VOICE IN THE ICE
story: Every night, Eira hears the same four notes. Tonight, the sound cracks a frost-covered window. Lina grabs her cloak: this time, they follow it.
art: Eira RIGHT half inside a tall cobalt castle window, turning toward a beautiful branching crack glowing in the frosted glass. Lina behind her pulls on navy cloak. A distinct small ice bell hangs beside the cracked window at lower right. Moonlit fjord beyond.
question: Eira ___ a mysterious voice every night.
why: With he, she or it, most present-simple verbs take -s: Eira hears.
alt: Eira RIGHT half inside a tall cobalt castle window, turning toward a beautiful branching crack glowing in the frosted glass. Lina behind her pulls on navy cloak. A distinct small ice bell hangs beside the cracked window at lower right. Moonlit fjord beyond.

title: CHOOSE YOUR WAY NORTH
story: The road ends at a wall of blue mist. A narrow ice ridge climbs above it; an old forest trail leads straight through. Bram checks the rope while Rook sniffs the snow.
art: Bram and Rook on RIGHT at a dramatic fork: icy cliff trail above, luminous forest arch below. A weathered wooden trail marker without lettering has a large blue compass medallion on it lower right. Distant mist wall spans horizon.

options.reason: You check the rope and keep the group together.
The shortcut saves time, but the mist hides the path.

alt: Bram and Rook on RIGHT at a dramatic fork: icy cliff trail above, luminous forest arch below. A weathered wooden trail marker without lettering has a large blue compass medallion on it lower right. Distant mist wall spans horizon.

title: ONE STEP AT A TIME
story: Lina goes first across the frozen ridge. A sharp sound travels beneath her boots. Eira braces the ice while Bram holds the rope tight.
art: MAIN ACTION LEFT: Lina crossing a narrow ice bridge above a vast ravine, Bram anchors a thick climbing rope and Eira stabilises the bridge with ice magic. A strong brass rope anchor driven into ice prominently lower left. Deep blue atmosphere, wind-driven snow.
question: The ice ___ under our boots.
why: The subject the ice is singular, so crack becomes cracks.
alt: MAIN ACTION LEFT: Lina crossing a narrow ice bridge above a vast ravine, Bram anchors a thick climbing rope and Eira stabilises the bridge with ice magic. A strong brass rope anchor driven into ice prominently lower left. Deep blue atmosphere, wind-driven snow.

title: THE FOREST WHISPERS
story: The travellers step between enormous silver trunks. Leaves circle them, although the branches stand still. Nim insists that the trees know their names.
art: Eira and Nim RIGHT inside an enormous blue silver-birch grove, glowing leaves spiral around a carved stone with a clear leaf-shaped sapphire inset lower right. Mysterious layered mist, block trees towering beyond.
question: The trees ___ when the wind spirit passes.
why: With plural subjects such as the trees, use the base verb: whisper.
alt: Eira and Nim RIGHT inside an enormous blue silver-birch grove, glowing leaves spiral around a carved stone with a clear leaf-shaped sapphire inset lower right. Mysterious layered mist, block trees towering beyond.

title: THE INVISIBLE GUIDE
story: A whirlwind sweeps Lina off her feet, then sets her gently beside an ancient symbol. Eira watches the leaves form an arrow toward the mountains.
art: RIGHT: Lina hovers just above snow in a gentle twisting blue whirlwind, Eira reaches toward her. A glowing leaf-arrow forms above a small stone spiral marker lower right, giant trees and frozen stream beyond. Faces unobstructed above centre.
question: ___ the wind spirit show them the way?
why: Use Does + singular subject + base verb: Does the spirit show…?
alt: RIGHT: Lina hovers just above snow in a gentle twisting blue whirlwind, Eira reaches toward her. A glowing leaf-arrow forms above a small stone spiral marker lower right, giant trees and frozen stream beyond. Faces unobstructed above centre.

title: A SMALL FLAME, A HUGE SHADOW
story: A frightened blue fire-lizard hides beneath a root. Across the valley, stone giants stamp toward the river. The group cannot follow both signs at once.
art: RIGHT: small cobalt glowing fire-lizard beneath an icy root, Nim kneels nearby; gigantic stone giant silhouette moving across snowy valley behind. A distinct luminous blue ember on a stone lower right. Keep fire blue with restrained warm spark accents.

options.reason: A gentle approach earns the spirit’s trust.
Their footsteps reveal a route to the river.

alt: RIGHT: small cobalt glowing fire-lizard beneath an icy root, Nim kneels nearby; gigantic stone giant silhouette moving across snowy valley behind. A distinct luminous blue ember on a stone lower right. Keep fire blue with restrained warm spark accents.

title: A GENTLER KIND OF MAGIC
story: Eira cools the burning roots with a soft layer of snow. Nim stays close, but keeps his twig hands away from the bright flames. The little spirit finally stops shaking.
art: MAIN ACTION LEFT: Eira crouches with an open gloved hand beside a tiny friendly blue fire-lizard on a snowy root, Nim beside her. Clear little fire-lizard lower left with sapphire glow. Gentle interaction, charred trees turn snowy blue.
question: Nim ___ touch the flames.
why: Use doesn’t + base verb with he, she or it: Nim doesn’t touch.
alt: MAIN ACTION LEFT: Eira crouches with an open gloved hand beside a tiny friendly blue fire-lizard on a snowy root, Nim beside her. Clear little fire-lizard lower left with sapphire glow. Gentle interaction, charred trees turn snowy blue.

title: FOLLOW THE FOOTSTEPS
story: Bram leads the group between fallen boulders. The giants are awake again, and each step sends waves across a dark lake. Lina notices that they avoid one enormous dam.
art: RIGHT: Bram and Lina shelter behind a boulder while an immense block-built stone giant foot passes beyond them. A deep footprint filled with luminous blue water occupies lower right. Dramatic scale, moonlit lake, distant dam.
question: The giants ___ sleep when the forest is disturbed.
why: Use don’t + base verb with plural subjects: the giants don’t sleep.
alt: RIGHT: Bram and Lina shelter behind a boulder while an immense block-built stone giant foot passes beyond them. A deep footprint filled with luminous blue water occupies lower right. Dramatic scale, moonlit lake, distant dam.

title: THE STORY THEIR MOTHER TOLD
story: At a sheltered camp, the sisters remember a lullaby about a river that keeps the past. Their mother came from this forest. The voice may be calling Eira home.
art: RIGHT: Eira and Lina seated close at a blue-lit sheltered camp, sharing a silver family pendant shaped as two joined diamonds. Their hands hold pendant low right, small warm lantern and blue forest behind. Tender scene, no other characters.
question: Eira and Lina ___ a memory of their mother.
why: Eira and Lina means they. Use the base verb: they share.
alt: RIGHT: Eira and Lina seated close at a blue-lit sheltered camp, sharing a silver family pendant shaped as two joined diamonds. Their hands hold pendant low right, small warm lantern and blue forest behind. Tender scene, no other characters.

title: TWO PATHS TO THE TRUTH
story: The lullaby points across a dangerous sea. Old carvings beside the river may reveal the same secret. Eira trusts the voice; Lina trusts what people leave behind.
art: RIGHT: Eira and Lina beside a frozen river junction, Eira looks toward storm sea and glacier, Lina studies an ancient carved pillar. A luminous diamond compass embedded in the pillar lower right. Huge blue landscape.

options.reason: You brave the waves to follow the voice.

options.text: Study the river records with Lina

alt: RIGHT: Eira and Lina beside a frozen river junction, Eira looks toward storm sea and glacier, Lina studies an ancient carved pillar. A luminous diamond compass embedded in the pillar lower right. Huge blue landscape.

title: THE WATER GUARDIAN
story: A horse-shaped water spirit rises from a breaking wave. Eira lowers her hands and waits. To cross the sea, she must work with it rather than overpower it.
art: MAIN ACTION LEFT: Eira stands firmly on an ice floe beside a magnificent translucent blue WATER HORSE with angular voxel mane. She reaches calmly toward a small glowing ice rein at the horse chest lower left. Towering blue waves, no drowning or upside-down bodies.
question: ___ Eira need the guardian’s help?
why: A present-simple question uses Does + Eira + the base verb need.
alt: MAIN ACTION LEFT: Eira stands firmly on an ice floe beside a magnificent translucent blue WATER HORSE with angular voxel mane. She reaches calmly toward a small glowing ice rein at the horse chest lower left. Towering blue waves, no drowning or upside-down bodies.

title: THE RIVER REMEMBERS
story: Deep inside the glacier, Eira touches a wall of living ice. A memory appears: an old ruler builds the dam to control the forest, then calls it a gift.
art: RIGHT: Eira inside towering blue ice cathedral touches a clear memory crystal on a low pedestal lower right. Within a distant ice wall an abstract miniature scene of an old stone dam appears; no human ancestor faces required. Light shafts and ice reflections, no bookshelves.
question: The river ___ every promise and betrayal.
why: The river is singular: add -s to make remembers.
alt: RIGHT: Eira inside towering blue ice cathedral touches a clear memory crystal on a low pedestal lower right. Within a distant ice wall an abstract miniature scene of an old stone dam appears; no human ancestor faces required. Light shafts and ice reflections, no bookshelves.

title: WORDS CUT INTO STONE
story: Lina brushes snow from a carved pillar. Its pictures show a dam, trapped water and broken trust. This monument tells a different story from the one taught in the palace.
art: RIGHT: Lina brushes snow from a broad blue stone relief of a DAM and river, holding a small brass brush clearly visible lower right on a stone ledge. Her face above the tablet. Relief uses pictures only, no readable writing.
question: Lina ___ the carved pictures carefully.
why: For a consonant + y, change y to -ies with he/she/it: study → studies.
alt: RIGHT: Lina brushes snow from a broad blue stone relief of a DAM and river, holding a small brass brush clearly visible lower right on a stone ledge. Her face above the tablet. Relief uses pictures only, no readable writing.

title: THE BROKEN PROMISE
story: Behind the pillar, Lina finds a sealed box of records. The forest people never asked for the dam. Someone built it to weaken their home.
art: MAIN ACTION LEFT: Lina opens an ancient small stone record box on a snowy ledge, Nim helps hold its lid. Inside are stacked flat carved tablets; a broken silver seal lies prominently lower left. All tablets rest in box, nothing flying. Deep cobalt grove.
question: The old records ___ the truth about the dam.
why: The subject “the records” is plural, so use reveal without -s.
alt: MAIN ACTION LEFT: Lina opens an ancient small stone record box on a snowy ledge, Nim helps hold its lid. Inside are stacked flat carved tablets; a broken silver seal lies prominently lower left. All tablets rest in box, nothing flying. Deep cobalt grove.

title: THE PRICE OF THE DAM
story: The truth is clear: the dam traps the river and keeps the spirits angry. Breaking it can free the forest—but the released water will rush toward Northmere.
art: RIGHT: immense stone dam across a blue gorge, Eira and Lina tiny on a safe overlook, luminous water presses against a central cracked bronze floodgate wheel lower right. Strong diagonal view shows forest above and distant kingdom below.
question: The dam ___ the river’s natural flow.
why: A singular subject takes the -s form here: the dam blocks.
alt: RIGHT: immense stone dam across a blue gorge, Eira and Lina tiny on a safe overlook, luminous water presses against a central cracked bronze floodgate wheel lower right. Strong diagonal view shows forest above and distant kingdom below.

title: FREE THE RIVER
chapter: BRANCH IV · THE COST OF COURAGE
story: Lina knows what must happen. Bram can warn the town while she draws the stone giants toward the dam. Eira prepares to meet the flood downstream.
art: RIGHT: Lina on a high dam path holding a brass signal horn, Bram beside her turns toward the valley road. A huge stone giant approaches far behind. Signal horn rests on parapet lower right, blue storm light.

options.text: Warn the town before breaking the dam
options.reason: Your warning gives families time to reach high ground.
The forest is freed quickly; Eira must face a stronger emergency.

alt: RIGHT: Lina on a high dam path holding a brass signal horn, Bram beside her turns toward the valley road. A huge stone giant approaches far behind. Signal horn rests on parapet lower right, blue storm light.

title: GET EVERYONE TO HIGH GROUND
story: Bram rings the warning bell. Rook pulls a supply sledge uphill while families leave the waterfront. Once the town is warned, Lina leads the giants to break the dam.

title: A WALL OF WATER

question: The water ___ toward Northmere.

alt: RIGHT: Eira on translucent water horse races beside an immense curling blue wave toward a fjord town, small clear icy waypoint stone on foreground safe rock lower right. High-speed diagonal action, horse and rider anatomically coherent.

title: STRONGER TOGETHER
story: Eira raises a shining wall of ice while Lina guides the last travellers onto the high bridge. One sister redirects the water; the other keeps people moving.

question: Eira and Lina ___ together to protect the town.

title: THE MIST BEGINS TO LIFT
story: The river runs freely for the first time in generations. The spirits gather around the sisters. Eira offers a new promise: the kingdom and the forest will listen to each other.
art: RIGHT: Eira and Lina beside a newly flowing blue river, small blue fire-lizard and leaf spiral nearby, stone giants peaceful in distance. A distinct blue flower grows through snow lower right. Dawn light, hopeful opening in mist.
question: The spirits ___ angry anymore.
why: The verb be is different: use aren’t with plural subjects. Don’t add do or does.
alt: RIGHT: Eira and Lina beside a newly flowing blue river, small blue fire-lizard and leaf spiral nearby, stone giants peaceful in distance. A distinct blue flower grows through snow lower right. Dawn light, hopeful opening in mist.

title: GUARDIANS OF THE NORTH
story: The flood turns safely into the empty fjord. Northmere stands, the forest is free, and the sisters become a bridge between two peoples. Your careful choices and clear commands protect both homes.
art: RIGHT: Eira and Lina stand together on a blue ice bridge above a safe sunlit town and restored forest; Bram, Nim and Rook celebrate farther right. A silver joined-diamond crest set in a pedestal lower right. Vast cobalt sky and fresh blue river.

title: A RIVER REBORN
story: The forest is free and everyone reaches safety. The waterfront needs rebuilding, but Northmere and the forest people now work together. The sisters turn a difficult victory into a new beginning.

title: KEEP THE PROMISE
story: The spirits lead the travellers to safety. The river is free, but the town needs a long recovery. Eira and Lina begin again, one careful step at a time. Practise your commands and return for a stronger ending.
